_note: Every empirical constant in the model lives here. Each entry is user-overridable at the API, CLI (--assume key=value) and UI layer. `confidence` is honest: low means we could not find a primary source and the value is a community-reported ballpark.

driver_reserved_vram_fraction.rationale: nvidia-smi reports slightly less total memory than the nominal capacity (ECC/driver/page tables). e.g. an 80GB H100 reports ~81559 MiB of 81920 MiB nominal (0.44%).

cuda_context_bytes.rationale: CUDA context + cuBLAS/cuDNN workspaces + NVML per process, before any model load. vLLM reports this as part of 'non-torch memory'; commonly 0.3-0.9 GiB depending on driver and CUDA version.

nccl_buffer_bytes_per_rank.rationale: NCCL communicator buffers + CUDA IPC handles per rank when TP>1. Driven by NCCL_BUFFSIZE (default 4MiB per channel) times channels, plus graph-captured comm buffers. 0.5 GiB is the commonly observed delta between TP=1 and TP=2 non-torch memory.

cudagraph_base_bytes.rationale: Fixed cost of CUDA graph capture pools in vLLM when enforce_eager=False.

cudagraph_bytes_per_captured_size.rationale: Per captured batch size, vLLM holds graph node structures and static input/output buffers. vLLM's default capture list has ~35 sizes and total graph memory is typically 1-3 GiB.

prefill_activation_multiplier.rationale: Number of live hidden-size-shaped activation buffers during a prefill chunk (residual stream, qkv projection output, attention output, plus one transient). Flash-attention avoids materialising the S x S score matrix, so the quadratic term is excluded.

allocator_fragmentation_fraction.rationale: PyTorch caching allocator holds reserved-but-unallocated blocks. vLLM's profiling run measures peak reserved, not peak allocated, so a small slack remains.

mbu_decode.rationale: Model Bandwidth Utilisation achieved by a well-tuned decode kernel on a modern engine. Databricks measured 0.55-0.72 across model sizes on A100/H100.

mfu_prefill.rationale: Model FLOPs Utilisation for compute-bound prefill. PaLM reported 0.46 MFU for training; large-batch prefill lands in a similar band, lower for small hidden sizes.

quant_group_size.rationale: Default group size for GPTQ/AWQ int4 packing. Each group carries a scale (and a zero point for asymmetric schemes).

interconnect_efficiency.rationale: Fraction of peak NVLink/PCIe bandwidth achieved by NCCL all-reduce at the message sizes typical of TP (a few MiB).
